description: This file defines the DefaultEventHubCacheMonitor class, which extends DefaultCacheMonitor, for monitoring cache metrics in the Event Hubs streaming provider within Orleans. It constructs the monitor with specific dimensions related to Event Hub path and partition.

classes.name: DefaultEventHubCacheMonitor
classes.description: A cache monitor class for Event Hubs streaming provider, extending DefaultCacheMonitor, initialized with Event Hub path and partition dimensions.

methods.name: DefaultEventHubCacheMonitor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the monitor with Event Hub path and partition information.
